items.title: NatWest faces AGM showdown over ‘climate backtracking’
items.description: <p>Shareholders including the Church of England back call for protest votes against bank’s chair</p><p>NatWest is at risk of an embarrassing showdown at its shareholder meeting this week as investors and scientists call for an urgent reversal of what they describe as “climate backtracking”.</p><p>Campaigners including ShareAction are calling for protest votes against the bank’s chair, Rick Haythornthwaite, at its annual meeting in Edinburgh on Tuesday.</p> &lt
